# Separate cleaning fee, or roll it into the nightly rate?

> Free cleaning fee calculator for Airbnb and VRBO hosts: the fee that covers your cleaner, host profit and guest total price by stay length, and whether to roll the fee into the nightly rate. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
